**[P2] Contain cancellation from plugin factories**

The factory contract says raised failures are logged and skipped, but `except Exception` excludes `asyncio.CancelledError`, which inherits `BaseException`. An async-backed factory surfacing cancellation therefore aborts the durable invocation and prevents healthy factories from running. Catch cancellation or other non-process-control `BaseException`s while still re-raising `KeyboardInterrupt`, `SystemExit`, and `GeneratorExit`; add a cancelled-factory regression test.
